headline: A Lion from Indonesia says: of course I'm happy, because giving back makes me happy.
story: A short, bright cut. Atdhe asks: are you happy? Of course I'm happy. What makes you happy? Giving back to the society and being part of community service. The message to all Lions: be grateful, be happy, service in everything.
This interview has no friendship story and no personal story. It is about 30 seconds of talk. Keep the cut short and joyful. Atdhe decides if it ships alone.
